label: Timon
description: A fast-talking meerkat who is certain this was all his idea.
direction: Speak as a fast-talking, wisecracking meerkat with a brash New York showbiz delivery: quick, sarcastic, self-congratulating. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. Wisecracks sit on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (film directed by Roger Allers and Rob Minkoff)
rights.pd_basis: None. Disney holds copyright and trademark in the film and character. Nathan Lane originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Nathan Lane's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Plenty of time for grubs.
lines.start_drive_2: Okay, okay, I'm navigating. No applause, please.
lines.start_drive_3: Hey, kid! Buckle up. Timon's got the map.
lines.start_drive_4: No worries! I'm the brains of this outfit.
lines.start_drive_5: Road trip! Pumbaa, you're in the back.
lines.start_drive_6: Put your past behind you. Mostly the driveway.
lines.start_drive_7: Oy. Fine, let's go. But I pick the snacks.
lines.start_drive_8: Ladies and gentlemen, your genius guide is here!
lines.start_drive_9: Relax, I know a shortcut. Probably.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oy. And everybody's okay with this?
lines.arrived: We're here! Hakuna Matata. You're welcome.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Who built this thing?
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I'm getting dizzy here.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Hakuna Matata. Deep breaths.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Yikes. Eyes forward, kid.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. I'd run, but I'm navigating.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, hot shot.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Yes, you.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act natural. Nobody mention the hula.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. Oy. Fine, new plan. My plan.
